title: Hidemi Ohta (太田秀美 )from the Great Teacher Onizuka (GTO) [LORA/Anima]
description:
Here's Hidemi Ohta (太田秀美 )from the Great Teacher Onizuka (GTO). She's an interesting character. She's quite manipulative and vindictive for the first 3/4 of her character arc. She specifically uses her parent's status to manipulate her teachers to do her bidding. She is then ironically kidnapped due to her parent's status and has a massive change of heart when a target of her vindictiveness (Onizuka) ends up being her rescuer.

This lora will likely be helped with the use of retro style or GTO style specific loras and retro anime prompts. Depending on how your results are turning out, you might want to remove "large expressive eyes" that I put in. I put that trigger in when my dataset was mostly upper body and head shots from the Anime but full body results with that tag might lead to messed up eyes.

Triggers Illustrious: hidemi, freckles, brown hair, twin braids, long braids, bangs, curtain bangs,brown eyes, large expressive eyes, glasses, silver half-rim glasses, curvy

A local desktop tool that generates properly formatted prompts for MiniMax Hailuo 3.0 (H3) video. Supports Reference-to-video + audio (RF2VA), Text-only, First frame, and First+Last frame modes. Runs completely offline after setup using your own Qwen GGUF model.

  • Live token streaming and cancel button

  • Strict H3 template output

  • Fully portable — no ComfyUI or system Python required

  • Auto-opens the browser

Requirements

  • Windows

  • NVIDIA GPU with a recent driver (CUDA 13.x compatible recommended)

  • A Qwen3.8-VL GGUF + matching mmproj file

Setup

  1. Download and unzip the package.

  2. Put your GGUF and mmproj files inside the models folder (or set the paths in the UI).</
